build_pointnet2_backbone: build a Pointnet2Backbone network for point cloud feature learning with configurable input feature dimensions
run_pointnet2_forward: run a forward pass of Pointnet2Backbone on a batch of point cloud tensors to extract multi-scale features
build_sparseconv_backbone: build a SparseConvBackbone network using MinkowskiEngine sparse convolution for 3D point cloud feature extraction
run_sparseconv_forward: run a forward pass of SparseConvBackbone on sparse tensor inputs with furthest point sampling
review_break_up_pc: review the Pointnet2Backbone _break_up_pc method that splits point cloud tensors into xyz coordinates and features
